dedupe_keys.name: imbalance prices per minute near real time

description: Imbalance prices per minute (Near real-time) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. The 1 min imbalance prices are published as fast as possible and give an indication for the final imbalance price of the ISP (imbalance settlement period which is 15min). This report contains data for the current hour and is refreshed every minute. Notice that in this report we only provide non-validated data. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Market, Imbalance prices, Near real-time, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
